title: Fix erroneous string-plus-int log messages
body: These log messages are `const char*` + `int` and do not do actual string-appending. The integers need a `std::to_string` to properly up-cast this operation into a string-append by an integer-string
author: Wunkolo

comments.body: Thank you for fixing this. I missed to fix these when I switched from std::cout to the logMessage function.

title: Fix `Player` forward declaration error

title: Server fails to launch
body:
After building the server, it did not seem to connect to the auth server the first 2 times it ran. ``` user@machine:~/some/dir/MCppServer/build$ ./MCppServer [DEBUG] Created default level.dat. [INFO] Server started in 138 ms [INFO] Minecraft server is running on port 25565 [ERROR] Authentication request failed: No response from session server. stop [ERROR] [Console] Unknown command or invalid arguments. ^C ``` Is there some set up I am missing or is this caused by a bug?
I have tried to log in with both a 1.21.1 client and a 1.21.4 client.
author: Jonathan-L-Davis

comments.body: I could have chosen a better title, the error is actually the client and or server fails to Authenticate.

Are you running the server on Linux? The authentication is currently not working on Linux. You can turn off online mode, than you will be able to join. Web fetches are not working on Linux, so skins will also not work. But I am trying to fix this.
The problem should be fixed now. Web fetches and authentication should now work on Linux
